verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Isaiah 45

Cyrus "His anointed", a rare non-Israelite (Grogan); conquests via Xenophon (Trapp) and Herodotus; Babylon entered by diverting the Euphrates (Herodotus), inner bronze gates "inexplicably unlocked"; largely bloodless (Motyer); "I form the light and create darkness" against Persian dualism (Bultema); 45:13 Cyrus frees the exiles "not for price"; 45:23 and Phil 2:10–11
